items.title: UHB opens market engagement on a £2.5m digital-first obesity service for the West Midlands
items.summary: University Hospitals Birmingham NHS Foundation Trust, on behalf of Health Innovation West Midlands, has published a preliminary market engagement notice for the Obesity Pathway Innovation Programme, with an estimated value of £2.5m.

items.title: Setmelanotide for treating acquired hypothalamic obesity in people 4 years and over [ID6542]
items.summary: Technology appraisal guidance — Draft guidance. Closes 17/12/2026.

items.title: ICBs fail to commission services for GPs to offer Wegovy for cardiovascular risk
items.summary: Exclusive Not a single ICB in England has confirmed they currently meet a statutory responsibility to commission services for GPs to prescribe and monitor Wegovy (semaglutide) for cardiovascular risk, six months after NICE recommended its rollout, Pulse has learnt.

items.title: Why GPs can’t prescribe Mounjaro; and new suicide warnings for starting SSRIs
items.summary: The new episode of Pulse in Focus: The Podcast for GPs is now live and available on all podcast platforms. Senior journalist Maya Dhillon talks to Pulse deputy news editor Anna Colivicchi about her new investigation into funding cuts for tirzepatide provision in general practice.

items.title: Investigation: How withdrawing local GP funding for Mounjaro is jeopardising access
items.summary: As part of our new investigation The Weight of GLP-1 Cuts, Anna Colivicchi looks at what the withdrawal of local services for GPs to provide and monitor Mounjaro means for practices and patients ‘People who meet the national NHS criteria will be able to access Mounjaro through their usual GP practice,’ says a message…

items.title: Exclusive: Most ICBs withdraw services for GPs to prescribe and monitor Mounjaro
items.summary: Exclusive Most ICBs across England have withdrawn locally commissioned services for GPs to prescribe and monitor Mounjaro, a Pulse investigation has found.

items.title: Oral GLP-1 Tracker launched: Lilly Foundayo holds steady as Wegovy pill dips 5%
items.summary: Fierce Pharma has launched a weekly tracker using IQVIA data on prescription trends and market share for Novo Nordisk’s Wegovy pill and Lilly’s Foundayo.

items.title: Redefining obesity would be a weight off my mind
items.summary: Copperfield wonders whether, if changing BMI to waist circumference can make so many people healthier on paper, there are other areas of general practice where a simple change of metric could work wonders Some good news for once. That obesity timebomb they keep talking about may be just a damp squib.

items.title: Moving to new obesity definition could prevent widescale ‘misdiagnosis’
items.summary: Moving to an updated measure of obesity that goes beyond body mass index (BMI) could save the NHS time and money through avoiding misdiagnosis, UK researchers have concluded. Two separate studies have shown poor performance of BMI as an indicator of health across adults in the UK and internationally.

items.title: Stopping GLP-1s associated with increased risk of heart attack and stroke, study finds
items.summary: Stopping GLP-1 treatment is associated with a substantially increased risk of heart attack, stroke or death, a new study has found.

items.title: MPs call for wider access to weight-loss drugs for people with obesity
items.summary: Influential MPs have called on NHS England (NHSE) to “urgently reassess” what they called its current “unambitious” plan for rolling out weight-loss injections, which relies heavily on nursing staff.

items.title: Greater national oversight needed for obesity treatment, urges parliamentary committee
items.summary: Services to treat obesity should be ‘overhauled and reimagined’, a cross-party parliamentary committee has said. The Health and Social Care Committee is urging the government to reframe obesity as a ‘chronic, relapsing condition with life-long physiological impacts’ and adapt how patients receive treatment.
